risk_statement: A five-to-eight-person guided departure enters regulated Amsterdam Centre without the guide-specific exemption
preventive_control: Roster and route permit check before confirmation
response: Do not operate regulated section; switch approved route or cancel

risk_statement: The group obstructs a bridge entrance cycle path or business frontage
preventive_control: Approved stopping map and guide conduct briefing
trigger: Stopping point unsafe crowded or obstructive
response: Move immediately; log and revise stop

risk_statement: A published accessibility promise cannot be delivered across the complete journey
preventive_control: Accompanied field audit and claim approval
response: Contact guest; offer effective alternative refund or reschedule

risk_statement: A guest is injured by traffic bicycles paving weather or crowd conditions
preventive_control: Dynamic route check briefing pace control and emergency procedure
response: Stop service protect guest contact emergency support and record incident

risk_statement: Booking information omits a material limitation inclusion or cancellation term
response: Correct page notify affected customers and provide remedy

risk_statement: Unnecessary health or accessibility details are collected retained or exposed
preventive_control: Data minimisation access control retention rule
trigger: Sensitive data requested or accessed without need
response: Restrict access delete excess data assess breach duty

risk_statement: Sensitive history is sensationalised or residents are treated as scenery
preventive_control: Source review guide script principles and correction process
trigger: Complaint factual error or dignity concern
response: Pause claim correct interpretation and brief guides

risk_statement: Noise crowding or repeated stops create resident or business nuisance
preventive_control: Eight-guest cap dispersed route and complaint log
response: Switch stop reduce dwell and review route

risk_statement: Guide lacks valid permit briefing competence or backup
preventive_control: Document verification training roster and backup guide
response: Block assignment and activate qualified backup

risk_statement: The product makes broad sustainable claims without measured evidence
trigger: Claim lacks defined measure and period
response: Remove or qualify claim; collect evidence

risk_statement: Heat rain wind or ice makes the planned route unsafe
preventive_control: Same-day weather and surface check with route variants

risk_statement: Works or transit disruption removes a safe crossing stop or recovery option
trigger: Closure diversion or inaccessible surface found

risk_statement: Activity or territory is outside confirmed liability cover
preventive_control: Written insurer confirmation before paid pilot
response: Do not launch until adequate cover is confirmed

risk_statement: Responsible controls increase cost beyond the Article 08 contribution floor
preventive_control: Rerun unit economics after verified permit insurance and guide costs
response: Revise price channel or product; do not dilute controls

risk_statement: A serious complaint is dismissed rather than investigated and closed
preventive_control: Complaint ownership severity rules and CAPA log
trigger: Safety accessibility dignity or resident complaint received
response: Acknowledge contain investigate correct and communicate
